Morgan Lin: Hey everyone — day 1! Quick qs: what do I need to do for MDM enrollment? VPN access? Also who to ping for a spare monitor + sticker pack? :party-parrot:
Ava (People Ops): Welcome Morgan! :wave: You should get an invite to the MDM portal within ~30 mins. If not, DM me.
Jamie (IT): Hi Morgan — I sent the VPN onboarding link: https://company-ssg.example/vpn-setup. Follow the macOS section. If you hit the 'cert not trusted' step, run:
```
sudo security add-trusted-cert -d -r trustRoot -k /Library/Keychains/System.keychain ~/Downloads/company_root.crt
```
Sasha N.: Also tag me if you want a dual monitor — we have a spare 24" for platform folks.
Devon T. (buddy): Hey! I'll set up a 30-min sync for tomorrow to run through infra stack and Slack/Docs. Lunch group meets at 12:30 in #lunch-plans.
mdm-bot: Device registered: macbook-pro-morgan (serial ends with 3F9). Enrollment status: pending profile install.
Morgan Lin: Thanks all — DMing Ava and Jamie now. Also — two truths and a lie: I used to be a pastry chef, I speak 4 languages, I once coded a game in 48 hours. Guess? :thinking:
Sasha N.: Guessing pastry chef is truth, 4 languages true, 48h game is lie? :grin:
Ava (People Ops): Welcome again! Sticker request noted, sending to facilities. :sparkles:
